The '''lodging and hospitality quarter''' was an area of [[Point Ueda]], the [[planet]] [[Ueda]]'s [[capital]] [[city]]. The city once housed the administrative offices of a lucrative logging operation based on the valuable [[Ueda conifer]] and was home to the operation's mill workers. The city was built upon the slope of a hill on one of the world's archipelagos and the lodging and hospitality quarter fell about halfway up the slope.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> the logging and milling operation on Ueda had ended<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> but the lodging and hospitality quarter remained.<ref name="LostFound">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The lodging and hospitality quarter appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="LostFound" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> It was then identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
